description_zh: 创建一个防勒索恢复任务
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-restore-job --uuid inet-ecs-4e876cb0-09f7-43b8-82ef-4bc7a93769b5 --snapshot-id s-00023dhaatxp18mh0000 --snapshot-hash d4b399edaad94b038e8f91873f19e3eae010ca30798fc36db3a164dd343f0000 --target /root/testfls --vault-id v-0002n12wokck2q0x0000 --snapshot-version 1655705440000 --includes root --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRestoreJob

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server whose data you want to restore
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the snapshot that you want to use for restoration.

You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要恢复的快照id。
调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
The hash value of the snapshot.

You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
快照hash值。
调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: snapshot_hash

parameters.help_en: The path to which you want to restore data
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: backup snapshots for Elastic Compute Service (ECS) files
File: backup snapshots for on-premises servers
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值范围：
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件的备份快照。
File：表示本地服务器备份快照
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup vault that is used in the restoration task.

You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
恢复任务的备份仓库id。
调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the backup data.

You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
服务器数据的恢复版本（即备份版本）。
调用[DescribeSnapshots](~~DescribeSnapshots~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: snapshot_version

parameters.help_en: The directory in which the files included in the restoration task are located. This parameter is specified when you create the anti-ransomware policy. The value is a directory that requires protection
parameters.help_zh: 恢复文件中所包含的目录。该目录是在创建防勒索防护策略时指定的，即需要防护的目录
parameters.name: includes

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
